summary: First backend testing pass for Wholesale SaaS Phase 1. Wrote comprehensive pytest suite covering all 20+ modules requested: auth, products, categories, banners, shipping, bank accounts, vendors, orders (incl. server-side recalc, MOQ, CGST/SGST vs IGST split, cross-customer 403, cancel-after-shipped guard), quotes (customer price-recompute prevention vs staff-trusted, convert flow + double-convert guard), invoices (idempotent, customer scoping, email stub), payments (overpay/zero/partial/exact/paid transitions), customer portal (me/dashboard/addresses/wishlist), returns (window, ownership, reason=defect switches shipping-payer to store, pipeline transitions), print jobs (vendorCost/vendorId hidden from customer, customer-approve-only-from-proof_sent), users (admin-only, staff blocked = FR-8 satisfied), settings (public whitelist excludes geminiApiKey, staff blocked from full/PUT), dashboard/export CSV/activity-log role gating, and cross-cutting sweep verifying customer/anonymous NEVER get 200 on privileged endpoints. All 67 tests PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: Payments.by-invoice endpoint uses get_session (any authenticated user), not require_roles admin/staff. A customer with a valid token can query payment records for ANY invoice ID via /api/payments/by-invoice/{id}, including invoices they don't own. Currently mitigated only by the fact that invoice IDs are hard to guess, but this is not proper authorization. Recommend adding customer-ownership filtering or restricting to admin/staff.

Invoice.customerId is set from order.customerId at creation, but if invoice is created for a guest order (customerId==''), any customer whose customerId also=='' would match — however GET /api/invoices customer query filters on session['user_id'] which is a real ObjectId, so this is safe in practice. Guest invoice access is admin-only, which is correct.

seed.py does NOT seed the buyer1@example.com customer referenced in /app/memory/test_credentials.md — the credential doc lies. Tests worked around this by registering their own customers. Either seed buyer1 or update the credentials file.

Order status transition allows any admin/staff status change without enforcing the forward-only pipeline (e.g., delivered -> pending is currently allowed). The spec only tightens cancel-after-shipped and terminal-cancelled guards, but a full FSM would be safer.
CORS is configured with allow_origins='*' and allow_credentials=False — fine for JWT-in-Header but blocks any future cookie-based auth; document intent.
gen_number() uses uuid.hex[:4] which gives only 65k possibilities per second — collision-safe for orders but consider bumping to 6+ chars for very-high volume.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (spec did NOT require it for Phase 1, but flagging for later phases).

Order line-total floating-point: subtotal accumulates raw floats; not rounded. Consider rounding to 2 decimals when storing to avoid 1e-10 style noise in reports. Currently not observed as an issue because tier prices are integers.

Return.deliveredAt window check uses datetime.fromisoformat on stored ISO string — will fail if deliveredAt lacks timezone. now_iso() does include tz, so safe today, but any future manual insert without tz would crash the endpoint. Consider a defensive parse.

Print jobs GET /list for admin returns Pydantic model dumps that still include vendorCost/vendorId — correct — but there's no aliasing on the response schema, so any future response_model_exclude wouldn't help. Fine for now.
test_credentials: admin@example.com / ChangeMe123! (accountType=staff). Tests dynamically create test_buyera@example.com / buyerA123 and test_buyerb@example.com / buyerB123 (accountType=customer) and TEST_staff_isolated@example.com / staff-pass-123 (staff role via /api/users). buyer1@example.com from memory/test_credentials.md is NOT seeded — file is aspirational.
seed_data_creation: Tests auto-create test users prefixed with TEST_/test_ and are idempotent (409 on re-run is handled by falling back to login). Products/categories/shipping zones are consumed from server seed. Test data is not cleaned up but is namespaced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, 67 tests, all passing. Uses pytest with xdist parallel workers. Tests use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. Seed customer buyer1@example.com does NOT exist despite being in test_credentials.md — register instead. Frontend is intentionally the default CRA placeholder for Phase 1 — do NOT flag that as a bug. Chatbot/Knowledge Base is Phase 2, not built. Invoice email is a stub returning {sent:true, stubbed:true} — expected.
